verdict.rationale: Discord documents a REST API for interacting with Discord data, authenticated by bot token or OAuth2 bearer token. It also offers a Gateway WebSocket for server events such as channel updates and role creation, plus webhooks and interactions. Nothing in the pack shows these surfaces match the UI. Access is framed around bot and app integrations rather than a user doing everything they can in the client, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. Missing for 10: any evidence of UI/API parity, documented coverage of user-level actions (profile, Nitro features, friends) through the API, a published API spec, independent corroboration.
